text:
rachel: Flagging release notes + changelog work for docs v0.13. Main items: adaptive-batching docs, migration guide for embed-streaming removal, JS/Py snippet parity, and link/anchor hygiene. Who can drive final publish? ping @maya

maya: I’ll take publish ownership. Freeze for doc PRs in 48h. Post PR links here and call out blockers. :spiral_notepad:

otis: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5601 -- adaptive-batching doc + example showing config knobs. Needs copy polish and SDK examples converted to `rdw.text.generate` style.

lina: I'll run snippet smoke tests. Quick note: we should avoid including numeric latency or token counts in examples; keep outputs illustrative only.

rachel: Good call. Also include a short migration blurb for embed-streaming removal: point users to embeddings.v2 and provide contact path for Dedicated migrations.

maya: Draft behavioral-change blurb: "Adaptive batching now groups short requests to reduce per-token overhead; this can slightly change per-request latency profiles and sampling variance for bursty traffic." Thoughts?

otis: Fine, maybe shorten: "Adaptive batching groups short requests to reduce overhead; may affect per-request latency distribution." I added a 2-line YAML example in the PR: ```yaml
batching:
  mode: adaptive
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

lina: For SDK snippets, swap to: JS: `await rdw.text.generate({model: 'kestrel/v1', input: '...'});` Py: `client.text.generate(model='kestrel/v1', input='...')`. I'll check for stray `client.generate` references.

webops: Heads-up: we had a stale sidebar-anchor TTL issue last deploy. If users report 404s after merge, ping ops and I'll force a quick cache invalidate. Recommend adding a known-issues note.

maya: Known-issues draft bullets: - Sidebar anchor TTL: persisted stale anchors may appear briefly after deploy; ops can invalidate cache on request. - embed-streaming deprecation: migrate to embeddings.v2; contact SE for Dedicated migration assistance. - SDK alias: `client.generate` may be deprecated in certain SDK versions; prefer explicit `text.generate` call. Keep concise.

docs-bot: Release checklist: 1) All PR links posted 2) Snippets smoke-tested 3) Changelog entry in /changelogs/0.13.md 4) Known-issues included 5) Owner runs `/docs release-ready` to queue publish.

lina: ✅ snippet tested (JS + Py) - replaced old model spec and removed numeric perf values.

otis: Updated PR with shorter adaptive-batching blurb and a tiny example comparing `policy: latency` vs `policy: cost` routing. Also fixed two broken anchors to /docs/perf/caching#kv-cache and /docs/sdk/quickstart#install.

maya: I'll assemble the changelog blurb and open a small PR for /changelogs/0.13.md by tomorrow morning. If you merge after freeze, add a one-line changelog note to the PR so I can include it. :rocket:

rachel: Thanks — publish window slated for Thu 10:30 PT. If anything critical pops up, flag here and include the PR link.
